_comment: Words the WinUI pages say that the page itself has no key for: the desktop app writes its own descriptions in places the page put its words in a tooltip, or split the sentence differently. Keyed by the English the app says. gen-strings.mjs merges these after i18n.js, so a word the page translates is never written here twice. A language without a translation falls back to English.
